description: This file contains a controller class 'Language' within the OpenCart admin extension namespace, responsible for managing language extension modules, including listing, installing, and uninstalling language packs.

classes.name: Language
classes.description: Controller class for managing language extensions within the OpenCart admin interface, providing functionalities such as listing available languages, installing new language packs, and uninstalling existing ones.

methods.name: index
methods.description: Handles the default request, responds with the list of language extensions.

methods.name: getList
methods.description: Retrieves and prepares the list of language extensions, including their status and links for installation or removal.

methods.name: install
methods.description: Handles the process of installing a language extension, including permission checks, registering autoloaders, and triggering extension-specific install routines.

methods.name: uninstall
methods.description: Handles the removal of a language extension, including permission checks, default language validation, and triggering uninstall routines.
